Transition and shot quality, per team

Source: R/ratings.R
team_shot_profile.Rd

From the field-goal attempts of pressure_situations() (with xfg from expected_fg()): how often each team shoots early in the clock (early_share, at least early seconds left, mostly transition), points per early and per half-court shot, and the quality of the shots it takes and allows: expected points per shot from location alone (xpps, o_xpps) and how far actual points beat it (making, o_making).

Usage

team_shot_profile(shots, early = 17)

Arguments

shots

Output of pressure_situations(), with xfg.

early

Seconds left on the shot clock that count as early.
